references.text: This text describes Israel's victory over Sihon, king of Heshbon, and Og, king of Bashan, who are the same kings mentioned in Joshua 9:10.
Moses mentions the victory over Sihon, king of Heshbon, and Og, king of Bashan, who lived in Ashtaroth.
Detailed account of Israel's victory over Sihon, king of the Amorites in Heshbon.
Detailed account of Israel's victory over Og, king of Bashan, who lived in Ashtaroth.
Moses reminds the people of the victory over Sihon, king of Heshbon, and Og, king of Bashan.
The Lord will do to the enemies as He did to Sihon and Og, kings of the Amorites.
Rahab mentions how the Lord dried up the Sea of Reeds and what Israel did to Sihon and Og.
List of defeated kings including Og, king of Bashan, who lived in Ashtaroth.
Description of Sihon's kingdom in Heshbon and Og's kingdom in Bashan that were distributed to the Israelites.
The psalm praises the Lord who struck down Sihon, king of the Amorites, and Og, king of Bashan.
Praise for the victory over Sihon, king of the Amorites, and Og, king of Bashan.
Nehemiah mentions that God gave the Israelites the land of Sihon and the land of Og, king of Bashan.
